mem.10:
23 Jan 2023 — Jolene had a busy week and had finished an electrical-engineering project the week before. Deborah visited her late mother’s home and shared their last photo: two women in wheelchairs hugging. Her mother died years earlier; Jolene’s mother died in 2022. Deborah’s mother loved sitting by a window each morning, and Deborah sometimes sits there to feel close to her. Jolene’s mother gave her a heart-shaped bird pendant in Paris in 2010; it represents freedom and pursuing goals. Deborah also wears a pendant in her mother’s memory. She hopes to keep teaching yoga and supporting her community; yoga helped her through a hard time and inspired her to share peace and joy.

25–26 Jan 2023 — Deborah’s father died suddenly; the family was shell-shocked. She coped by being with family, cherishing memories, and trying to live fully. She shared a photo of two women embracing and her parents’ 1993 wedding photo. Deborah and her husband value love, openness, and mutual support and hope to build a family like her parents’. Her yoga group gave her a thank-you note on 26 Jan for her positive influence. She practices in her old home’s living room and feels her late mother’s presence by the window, where her mother read nightly; travel was also her mother’s passion. Deborah shared an airplane-window sky photo.
Jolene has snakes Susie and Seraphim. Susie calms and cheers her; Seraphim once escaped while Jolene gamed and curled beside her (photo: snake peeking from blanket). Jolene said she bought “it” in Paris a year earlier (referent unclear). She and her partner enjoy console games, including Detroit; planned to play Walking Dead on 4 Feb. Jolene learned gaming as a child.

31 Jan–1 Feb 2023 — Jolene enjoyed a demanding robotics project from her engineering professor (robot/laptop photo). Deborah met neighbor Anna at yoga in the park on 31 Jan; they discussed yoga and community. Deborah shared a yellow sign with a family picture. Jolene shared a purse and plant photo; instead of resuming yoga, she mentioned gaming with her partner.

3–4 Feb 2023 — Jolene completed a major project: designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community. Seeing it provide clean water felt surreal and satisfying, reaffirming her purpose to create sustainable solutions that help communities. Deborah advised her to breathe and remember her purpose during difficult times. Deborah and Anna bonded at yoga on 3 Feb; shared dance-studio and chair-yoga photos. Deborah described seated chair twist: sit at edge, feet planted, twist with hand on knee, hold a few breaths, switch; stretches back/shoulders and relieves tension.
Jolene read *Sapiens* and had read Neal Stephenson’s *Avalanche* in one sitting two weeks earlier. She mentioned a story about succeeding through belief and hard work despite challenges. Deborah’s friend gave her flowers that brought hope, courage, warmth, and appreciation. Deborah likes a park forest trail and nearby beach. Jolene shared a vacation beach photo from Bogota the prior summer; sunset was calming. Deborah finds peace at a small island with a lone boat near her mother’s old home, bringing her mother’s pendant/amulet for comfort and a sense of her love. Anna also wears a pendant for her mother.

8–9 Feb 2023 — Jolene took a mini-retreat on 8 Feb to reflect; felt energized and more confident after recognizing her achievements. She was progressing in engineering and wanted to explore green tech for disadvantaged areas. Proposed volunteering to teach STEM to underprivileged children through schools/community centers, with workshops and engineer guest speakers; hadn’t contacted organizations and wanted to firm up plan. Shared notebook/planner sketches and promised updates.

21–22 Feb 2023 — Jolene had dinner and drinks with friends on 21 Feb (food/wine photo). Deborah shared her bucket garden; roses and dahlias brought peace. A friend had died the prior week, and the garden comforted her in grief. Deborah called her photo with Karlie from the previous summer their last photo together: two women on a motorcycle on a dirt road. Bali, visited in 2022, was a favorite peaceful yoga destination (beach swing photo). Jolene wanted to try beach yoga and report back.

24–25 Feb 2023 — Jolene balanced engineering school, gaming with partner, yoga, and meditation. Yoga/breathing calmed her, gave perspective, and improved alertness/motivation, especially when overwhelmed. Her partner sometimes joins; yoga helps them relax and bond. Together three years, not married, taking it slow; a shared-hands/rings photo (his ring decorative). They met in engineering college, became friends then partners, enjoy engineering projects, and understand each other’s struggles (book/calculator and group-of-men/building photos).
Deborah’s self-care: morning meditation, yoga and teaching; first morning jog at nearby park on 24 Feb, hoped to make it routine; evenings with loved ones. Exercise connects her to her body. She shared sunset/bench photo and quote, “Can’t pour from an empty cup.” Jolene intended to prioritize self-care.

2 Mar 2023 — Deborah said Anna brought tasty vegan tofu-vegetable stir-fry with ginger and soy sauce. Jolene’s comfort food is lasagna; busy with studies/exams. Both did yoga/meditation the previous Friday to relax/reset; Jolene said quiet moments work wonders for the soul (room/window and purse/plant photos). Jolene took Seraphim to the park the previous Sunday; snake enjoyed exploring (snake/lizard among leaves photo); people are surprised it’s tame. Deborah enjoys birdsong and breeze; both feel nature helps slow down and appreciate little things.
Jolene wanted to better manage stress and mental health; exams/deadlines overwhelmed her (desk/notebook/monitor photo). Deborah encouraged her to break work into small pieces, set goals, use a planner/scheduler to stay organized and preserve self-time, and offered to help make a study plan. Deborah shared a yellow mug with an encouraging handwritten message and offered one; it cheered Jolene up.

13 Mar 2023 — After a gap, Deborah said she had started a neighborhood yoga class, hosting neighbors on Fridays; shared a group photo of women. She enjoys sharing yoga’s calming effects, bringing others peace/awareness, and building friendships/community. Jolene praised her and said support matters in tough times. Jolene said engineering assignments were hard to manage and asked to revisit time management. They agreed to find a time to talk; Jolene would check her schedule and get back to Deborah. Deborah reassured her she was available and urged self-care.

22 Mar 2023 — Deborah checked on Jolene’s exams/deadlines. Jolene said juggling everything felt like stressful catch-up. She used Pomodoro (25 minutes work, 5-minute break) to avoid burnout but struggled to prioritize. Deborah uses a daily schedule/to-do list and shared a notepad photo; Jolene shared an example of her own task notes, saying a big stack of tasks felt overwhelming and it was hard to know where to start. Deborah introduced the Eisenhower Matrix, sorting tasks into four boxes by importance and urgency, with a scissors-on-paper photo; Jolene found the visualization helpful and agreed to try it. Deborah encouraged self-care.
Deborah said she and Anna had sat by the sea watching sunset and talking, realizing they inspire each other. She shared a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard and asked what the sea made Jolene think of. Jolene thought of learning to surf but needed spare time. She had been gathering information, watching videos, and bought a beginner’s surfing guide; still needed to find the right time and place for a lesson. Deborah encouraged her to take steps, believe in herself, and enjoy the experience along the way; a photo showed surfboards leaning against a palm tree. Jolene felt supported and motivated to keep trying.

21 Feb–28 Mar — Jolene enjoys engineering studies, gaming with partner, yoga/meditation; partner sometimes joins. Together three years, not married, taking it slowly; met at engineering college, were friends first, share projects and understand each other’s struggles. Deborah’s self-care includes meditation, yoga/teaching, jogging, and loved ones; began jogging 24 Feb. Anna brought vegan tofu-vegetable stir-fry with ginger/soy. Jolene’s comfort food is lasagna. Jolene overwhelmed by deadlines; Deborah suggested small tasks, goals, planner and self-time. Deborah started Friday neighborhood yoga. Jolene solved a longstanding engineering-project problem. Both like lavender/rosemary, candles/essential oils. Jolene uses music for yoga; Deborah likes mellow instrumentals, especially “Savana”; Jolene listens to Nils Frahm and Ólafur Arnalds. Deborah recommended Sleep meditation.

Apr–9 Jul — Deborah biked with neighbor and attended art show; art evokes her late mother, who loved art as emotional/connecting. Jolene says snakes teach her to slow down; gaming with partner relaxes them and brings them closer. Jolene completed a solar-powered vehicle with a panel on back, then began internship at a well-known engineering firm; enjoyed applying school knowledge and seeing ideas realized, but work-life balance suffered. She did yoga on Mount Talkeetna. Deborah advised brief daily deep breathing. Deborah prepared a yoga retreat; Jolene was hectic at internship. Seraphim, acquired 2022, comforts Jolene; new aquarium bought 24 Jun. Deborah started running group with Anna and organizes mindfulness/self-care workshops. Jolene and partner enjoy It Takes Two. Jolene recalled finding an escaped snake snuggled under her bed.

1–19 Aug — Deborah started community cleanup/fundraising. Jolene’s project crashed in late July and work was lost; frustrated/depressed, but Susie (adopted in 2021 when lonely) and video games helped. Yoga/meditation and a meditation guide helped her regain calm/clarity. Jolene is building an affordable aerial-surveillance prototype for emergency response/environmental monitoring; makes notebook art/design inspired by space/engines. Jolene felt overwhelmed balancing engineering, relationship and personal growth; started a bullet journal. Deborah advised balancing personal needs. Jolene bought partner a console on 17 Aug; he managed to play. Deborah organized a yoga event last month with nearby businesses/venues, food stalls and live music. Jolene recommended Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch), Animal Crossing: New Horizons, and Overcooked 2; she and partner play for bets—she once won three large pizzas.

21 Aug — Jolene said they received Battlefield 1 for the console the previous week. Deborah revisited a place full of memories, sat on a bench where she and her mother used to talk, and felt nostalgia, longing and gratitude; brought flowers because her mother loved them and appreciated simple things. Deborah shared photos of flower cart, flowers on street, and her mother with red roses. Mother taught her to slow down, see beauty and find joy. Deborah walks, practices yoga/meditation and mindfulness to stay grounded; sunset walks feel like a “reboot.” Jolene is trying more yoga and meditation. Her favorite restful pose is savasana/corpse pose; she has practiced yoga for three years, using it to escape study/work stress, and said she was “finding my zen again.” Deborah encouraged her.

Deborah shared sunrise/beach photo of person walking with surfboard; beach walks calm Jolene; hoped to watch sunrise together. Deborah’s storm-cancelled yoga getaway disappointed her, but found comfort at home/work and little things. Jolene/partner planned camping. Planned coffee to discuss routines: settled on Friday 15 Sep after Monday/Wednesday didn’t work; Jolene would sort bookcase and bring interesting books.

Nature, reflection and break from engineering studies helped inner peace. Retreat taught relaxation/self-care/balance; standout session encouraged releasing expectations/judgments, savoring present and appreciating journey rather than fixating on goals. Trying mindfulness/gratitude, noticing small wins like sun or good coffee.

Shared living-room fireplace, pajama selfie with mother, beach-surfer photos. Beach special: Deborah married there and discovered surfing; joy/peace, beach yoga and self-care. Jolene creates serene yoga space with candles/oils/music. In Thailand they tried meditation “with flowers”; shared photo described as towels on a table. Jolene’s room is haven; shared bed with colorful blanket/pillows. Snake-in-container photo was Susie, her companion of 2 years. Deborah and neighbor ran free community gardening class 16 Sep; all ages joined; Deborah loves sharing plants and bringing people together. Jolene and partner tried scuba lesson 15 Sep, enjoyed it, found dive spot; may pursue certification. Deborah visited mother’s old house the prior Sunday and sat on bench, feeling mother’s presence.

20 Sep — Deborah enjoyed music festival with pals; freeing to dance/bop, music brings people together and expresses feelings; reminded her of mother singing lullabies. Jolene shared photo of herself and partner at a festival last year; festivals let her express herself and escape daily stress. Jolene had just returned from a trip with partner; photo showed man and woman standing in a field at night. They had an awesome yoga retreat; sunrise lit the sky in bright colors; shared photo described as sunset over valley with a horse. Yoga against the view made Jolene feel connected to nature and herself, peaceful and thankful.
